Markets.title: US stocks: US market slips as oil prices rise, retail results awaited
Markets.summary: US stock indexes fell as oil prices surged due to supply uncertainties and tensions involving Iran. Investors exercised caution ahead of upcoming retail earnings reports from companies like Home Depot and Walmart.

Markets.title: Gold appears set for a rebound as it regains safe-haven appeal after US-Iran war selloff
Markets.summary: Gold has rebounded nine percent following renewed safe-haven demand after the US-Iran war selloff. Lower oil prices and softer inflation data are supporting the metal's upward trajectory, though stalled peace efforts and weak demand could limit future gains.

Markets.title: Gold rises as weaker dollar, fading Fed hike bets lift demand
Markets.summary: Gold prices rose on Monday due to a weaker U.S. dollar and reduced expectations for Federal Reserve rate hikes. Investors also monitored Middle East geopolitical tensions for potential market impacts.

Markets.title: Copper hits over six-month high as LME supply concerns mount
Markets.summary: Copper prices hit a six-month high on Monday due to a significant drop in London Metal Exchange inventories. Other industrial metals also gained support from a weaker U.S. dollar.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Tuesday

Analysts report that upcoming stock market movements will be driven by crude oil prices, tensions in the Strait of Hormuz, and upcoming Federal Reserve minutes.

Markets.title: ICICI Bank raises $750 million as Indian banks tap dollar bond market
Markets.summary: ICICI Bank raised $750 million through five-year dollar bonds at 105 basis points over US Treasuries. This marks the bank's second dollar bond issuance within a month, driven by strong institutional demand.
